Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production transparent character sprite atlas for mobile MATCH ARENA game.
Input image is the approved three-panel design reference. Extract and faithfully reconstruct the SAME adorable fennec fox mascot: sandy cream fur, oversized ears, expressive brown eyes, small body, royal purple jacket with delicate gold trim. High-end sculpted 3D game render with dense fine fur and fabric, warm rimlight. This is a character sheet, NOT a UI or phone.
Output a single wide 1536x1024 PNG on TRUE TRANSPARENT background, exactly THREE equally wide columns (each 512px). Each pose fully contained in its own column, same mascot scale and foot baseline around 94% canvas height, tops at about 12%, no overlapping columns.
LEFT: neutral happy idle, eyes open, both paws resting on an invisible tabletop in front of torso at waist, seen front view, full ears/head/body visible.
CENTER: cheering combo pose, eyes joyfully closed, mouth open smiling, both arms up, ears expressive, purple jacket visible.
RIGHT: wink and proud victory pose holding a polished gold crown trophy above shoulder, full body and tail visible.
Keep each pose anatomically consistent. No background, no table, no decorative particles, no lettering, no UI, no checkerboard, no cast shadow extending outside each pose. Transparent empty separation. Match original fox in reference, not a human, not a toy, not an emoji.

Exactly 3 columns x 2 rows of equally-sized 512x512 cells, one item centered per cell with generous 12% transparent padding, all items same apparent size. Top row LEFT red ruby diamond with clipped corners, MIDDLE green emerald square cut with clipped corners, RIGHT vivid blue sapphire teardrop. Bottom row LEFT purple triangular amethyst, MIDDLE honey gold amber octagonal gem, RIGHT round faceted purple crystal orb. Extremely polished 3D-rendered transparent crystalline materials, brilliant refraction and many precise sharp internal facets, white beveled highlights, colored internal caustics, dark saturation on shadow side. Match reference silhouettes. Clean individual icons, no UI, no frames, no lettering, no badges, no checkerboard, no extra mini gems, no particles. Every gem contained strictly in its cell. Keep alpha transparency.
